title: vertex_ai/claude_* models aren't in MODEL_SETTINGS
body:
### Issue

When using e.g. `vertex_ai/claude-3-5-sonnet@20240620`, `aider` falls back to whole-file editing with no repo map.

It seems that the `MODEL_SETTINGS` const in [aider/models.py](https://github.com/paul-gauthier/aider/blob/main/aider/models.py#L35) will never match Vertex AI's Claude because the provider/**model** match expects `claude-3-5-sonnet-2024062` (hyphen before build identifier) rather than `claude-3-5-sonnet@2024062` (at-sign before build identifier)

### Version and model info

> Aider v0.39.0  
> Model: vertex_ai/claude-3-5-sonnet@20240620 with whole edit format  
> Git repo: .git with 23 files  
> Repo-map: disabled

linked_prs.title: Add support for vertex_ai/claude_* models
